General.Name: Dhani Services Limited
General.Description: Dhani Services Limited engages in the real estate development, broking, financing and digital wallet services, asset reconstruction, e-commerce, and related businesses through its Dhani app in India. The company offers personal loans, business instalment loans, etc.; and sells pharmaceutical products. It also provides card enabled prepaid payment program management and remittance services; and stock and commodity broking services. In addition, it engages in the cross selling of real estate; and asset reconstruction business of stressed assets. The company was formerly known as Indiabulls Ventures Limited and changed its name to Dhani Services Limited in October 2020. Dhani Services Limited was incorporated in 1995 and is based in Mumbai, India.
